newsitem.title: USA: Bell Industries has 95 pct of Milgray stock.
newsitem.headline: Bell Industries has 95 pct of Milgray stock.

text.p: Bell Industries Inc said Wednesday it had acquired, through a $14.77-a-share cash tender offer, about 95 percent of the outstanding shares of Milgray Electronics Inc. The offer expired January 7.

Bell announced November 27 its plan to acquire Milgray in a two-step transaction. By acquiring more than 66-2/3 percent of the outstanding Milgray shares, Bell met one of the key conditions of the acquisition agreement.
It said all remaining shares will be acquired at the same price through a cash merger expected to be completed January 15. No vote of Milgray shareholders is required, it said.
